LESSON: WRITING 5.5.1 LETTER OF APPLICATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.5: Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we write letters of application?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the components of a letter of application
2. write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WRITING 5.5.1 LETTER OF APPLICATION
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: WRITING 5.5.1 LETTER OF APPLICATION
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify the components of a letter of application

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the components of a letter of application. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the components of a letter of application.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the components of a letter of application. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components

What this means
In this part you learn to write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify the components of a letter of application)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application to a partner. (skill: write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the components of a letter of application.
3. Practise this skill: write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we write letters of application?
2. How can one ensure a letter of application meets the expected standards?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the components of a letter of application.
5. Be able to: write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
